title: Homemade Vanilla Pudding
description: Smooth, creamy stovetop vanilla pudding thickened with cornstarch and egg yolks. Far better than the boxed kind, and quick.

image.alt: Three glasses of vanilla pudding with whipped cream

steps.text: Whisk the sugar, cornstarch and salt in the saucepan, then whisk in the milk and yolks until smooth.
Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly and reaching into the corners, until the mixture thickens and a few big bubbles pop at the surface, {time 8-10 min}. Keep whisking for {time 1 min} more.
Take the pan off the heat and whisk in the butter and vanilla until smooth. For extra-silky pudding, press it through a sieve.
Pour into dishes, press plastic wrap onto the surface to stop a skin forming and chill until set, at least {time 2 hr notimer}.

notes: Save the egg whites for meringues or an omelet.
